in_sanskrit.name: Pentu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Pure, Clean, Simple
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pentu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pentu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pu' which means pure and 'Tu' which means clean or simple. This name signifies a pure and simple nature, and is often given to children who are believed to possess these qualities.
